Dialogs.Dialog: Because... you might think it's unladylike...
Geez. Don't look at me with such amused eyes.
(Forget it？ Now I'm even more curious！)
Hey. About that unladylike thing you mentioned the other day.
...Even though I asked you to forget it.
If you bring it up like that, of course I'll be curious.
Because when you're that interested... Your eyes are sparkling.
Too late. This conversation is over. Okay？
Yes... Um？ Do men, after they get out of the bath, um...
Is it normal for them to walk around the house in just their underwear？
A friend of mine is troubled because her dad won't stop even when she asks him to.
My dad never does that at home, so I couldn't give her good advice...
Hey, isn't there anything she can do？
My friend who was troubled about her dad？ She seems to have given up.
She said protecting herself is faster. She stays in her room around when her dad gets out of the bath.
...Hey, you do that too？ Being in your underwear after taking a bath...
Who knows... Maybe... Well, I live alone, so I don't need to be careful... Right？
...Then I'd better get used to it, I guess.
I wonder where everyone learns to do makeup.
Hmm, a guy can't even imagine...
Mama says she learned at a beauty school, in an extracurricular class.
Huh. Our school doesn't seem to have anything like that.
Right... Maybe I'll ask someone next time.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you want to wear makeup？
I thought maybe I should know a little. Because I want you to always think I'm cute...
...Saying it so casually doesn't make me happy.
There's a girl in my class who's really good at makeup.
She said my face would suit flashy makeup.
Don't you... want to see it？
If I said I wanted to see it, would you do it？
Mm... maybe I'd try？ Just kidding.
！ If you said no... I wouldn't, but...
But you'd want to see it, right？ Hey, say you want to see it？
(She wants me to give her a push...)
How's the Flashy Manaka Project going？ The makeup thing you mentioned.
Yes. It was amazing... I'd never seen anything like it...
I'm using it as a reference to practice at home.
I want to master it and transform on my own before you see it.
Yes. So, will you wait for me？
I'm sorry. Flashy makeup has been banned.
Papa saw me practicing... "It's not something high school students should do！" he said.
Yes. The magazine I used as a reference didn't help either.
There was this amazing hairstyle called "mega volume," so I copied that too. Mama helped me...
Hair like a chocolate cornet, and flashy makeup. Hehe, I went too far.
So makeup waits until after graduation. Wait until then, okay？
Ah. Is it your teeth, maybe？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, did you go to the dentist？
What do you mean, what？ You were in pain the other day, right？
Geez, come on. I have no idea what you're talking about.
(Brushing it off like that... Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ hate the dentist？)
Hey, have you been to the dentist recently？
I went just once when I was little... I was wondering what it's like now.
And you haven't had a toothache since then？
You seem like you'd brush properly, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I... I still can't forget that sound.
That sound when they drill your teeth...
Ah... I'm sorry. I made you worry.
Yes. I thought it wasn't good after all... so I went to the dentist.
I see, I'm glad！ How was it？
It wasn't a cavity. A cut on my gums was causing the pain.
A cut on your gums？ How？
I was brushing my teeth, right？ My hand slipped... too much force...
Ah, so that was it！ That happens a lot！
...You said you wouldn't laugh. Geez, hmph！
Hey, do you know any interesting classes or lessons？
No. Not me, it's for Mama.
Lessons someone your mom's age would enjoy, huh...
She says she wants something a little unusual that nobody else does.
Huh... Well, if I find anything, I'll tell you.
Thank you. I'm counting on you.
You know？ I found a few lesson options for Mama.
Yes. There were some unusual ones, but she didn't seem to like them much.
I see. Was there anything you wanted to try, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
But it seemed more like a school than lessons, so probably not.
Mama started attending a yoga class.
Ah, she ended up doing yoga.
She teaches me the poses she learned, too. She seems to really enjoy it.
Mm... Not right now, I think.
Because I'd have less time with you, and I don't want that.
Right？ Just kidding. It might be nice if there were lessons we could do together, though？
True... Want to look for some？
(I wonder what kind would be good.)
I looked up lessons we could do together...
I see... They feel kind of grown-up, somehow.
Yes, not quite right, are they.
Yeah. Actually, we already play tennis！
Then... lessons together can wait until we're grown up？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, what happened to your hand？
Yes... I cut my nails too short.
Cut them too deep, huh... I hear that's not good.
I know, right？ ...I just did it.
It shouldn't affect tennis or piano, though.
Yep, they look nice. You pass！
I asked a friend about my nails, and she said, "Why not try nail art？"
Yes. Or putting on glittery stickers.
You think so？ Maybe I'll try... but.
I have club and piano, and besides...
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Did you give up on nail art？
Yes, I gave up. I can't make them sparkly, but I thought I'd at least keep them nicely groomed.
Uh-huh. Then right away... let's see？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s nails are pretty enough without any stickers！)
Ah, the one who's always challenging you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Yes. The other day, she and I played a funny-face game.
Funny-face game？ Not a staring contest？
A staring contest is just about making the other laugh, right？ The funny-face game is about how different from normal your face can look.
And also, how much you can make the other person laugh...
(What kind of face did she make？)
She keeps leveling up. I want to strike back, but...
Strike back, with a funny face？
Yes. But I have no idea what to do.
Hmm. Isn't copying her the quickest way？
Too hard？ Then maybe ask her to teach you.
...That won't work. Her attitude is that skills aren't taught, they're stolen.
Maybe I'll practice alone with the mirror in the bath... I wish I had something to use as a reference.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, is your funny-face practice going well？
I think I can do it better than before？
But she's several levels above me. I don't think I can win.
She's so good that you'd say that, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
No way. It'd be trouble if you got hooked on her too.
She belongs to Manaka. Just kidding.
By the way, are you still doing the funny-face game？
No. She seems to have gotten bored...
I see. I'm still curious, though. About your funny face, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes. I'm sure there are still lots more. I want to see all your different expressions.
Yeah. I wonder when I'll have seen them all.
It might take a lifetime, you know？
I got home a little late. Mama stood up for me, though.
But I was the one who was late.
Hmm, he really is strict, your dad.
But he's kind. It's not that serious, so don't worry, okay？
Well, I find it pretty easygoing... Why？
Don't tell me, you want to live alone？
I was just thinking about it a little.
Haha, you don't need to, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
True, but even I want to spread my wings sometimes.
▲高嶺＊＊▲？ ...Don't tell me your dad scolded you again.
Last time it was coming home late, right？ What was it this time？
He found I was secretly watching a variety show.
Hey, did your father scold you again？
Not really lately... Thank you for worrying.
It's really not a big deal.
Then that's fine. I guess I worry too much.
It's just... He's always been strict, but lately it feels a little different.
How should I put it... lately it's a bit unreasonable. Even though he's someone who hates things that don't make sense.
Maybe it's my imagination. Papa himself seems a little unsure when he scolds me.
So it wasn't like that before.
I found out why Papa's been scolding me unreasonably.
Well, Mama thought it was strange too, and confronted him.
"Dear, you've been hard on Manaka lately. You're the one acting strange," she said.
So direct. Your mom's tough. And what did he say？
Yes. When I come home late from a date, talk on the phone for ages, or text in the living room... he just gets angry for no reason.
Hehe, that cleared things up. Thinking about it that way, Papa seems kind of cute.
(I don't feel cleared up at all...)
What would you do if the wind was too strong to sleep？
Yes. So I'd like to have a plan ready.
So even you can't sleep sometimes, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Ah. What's that supposed to mean？
Geez. That time I couldn't sleep and was up until midnight, you know.
By the way, that wind you said kept you up... how strong was it？
Um... strong enough that the bucket on the second-floor balcony disappeared.
Yes. We found it in the yard, so it was fine, but...
Something similar happened before, so Mama was supposed to be careful, but...
Yes. Once on a windy day, she was airing out the pillows, and one blew onto the neighbors' roof.
What happens twice happens three times... It'll probably fly off again...
Remember I asked you how to sleep on windy nights？
Mm... I tried something I thought would work, but it failed.
Then I got bothered by the sound of my own breathing...
I ended up staying up late, but I didn't break my record.
I was too half-hearted. Next time I have to pick one or the other.
(You're trying hard at the wrong thing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
By the way, how's the Strong Wind Insomnia Countermeasure going？
Hehe, you make it sound so cool.
It's weird, you know？ It seems like I'm used to it now... I've been able to sleep normally, recently.
It's just that... I feel like I'm becoming less sensitive...
Don't worry about it. I mean, you were never that sharp to begin w――
Fine. I'm plain and dense to begin with.
Yes, you know？ A friend of mine might be falling in love.
She's been getting lots of texts lately from someone she likes.
When she talks about it, she looks so happy...
And it's rubbing off on you, so you're grinning too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez, grinning？ ...Well, yes, maybe I am grinning.
(Feels like it might rub off on me too.)
How's your friend's love story going？
That grin... looks like it's going well？
They've gone from texting to talking on the phone.
Well, that's something to grin about.
Right？ It's like she's sharing her happiness with me.
Yes. I was thinking, I was the same way.
Love really is wonderful, isn't it？ I'm glad I fell in love with you.
By the way, any progress with your friend's romance？
Well, things don't change that dramatically.
You know？ A message for you. From my friend.
"Let's go on a double date soon, and give me and him a push！" she said.
Ah, that's what they mean. Bring it on！
Wouldn't it be nice if we could be their matchmakers？
Right, maybe that was jumping ahead a bit. Hehe.
By the way, that double date you mentioned... what happened？
Mm... I think it'll be a while yet？
Aw. I was going to push them as hard as I could.
But, my friend was very pleased with your reply, you know？
"What a reliable boyfriend," she said, all jealous.
Hey, does your beard grow too？
A beard？ Well, sure, it grows.
Whenever he comes home after drinking, he always rubs his stubbly chin on her.
So we started talking about why men's beards are so stiff.
(She laughed. I didn't mean it as a joke...)
What？ Is there something on my face？
No. I was wondering what you'd look like with a beard.
Like the great men in history textbooks？
That kind of beard seems to be quite hard to grow, you know？
I see. But I want to see it？
Um... Oh, photos！ The basic way is to doodle on a photo first！ Right？
The beard doodle we talked about... Did you try it？
Yes. I asked a friend who's good at that kind of thing, and she made lots of versions.
That's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ for you... Going all the way...
I want to see the real one▼
Yes▼ Manaka wants to see all kinds of you？
I was imagining it, and I really wanted to see it.
Yes, it suits you. Keep it on all day today？
Just let me take a picture？ I'll treasure it until I can see the real thing▼
(Will that be a treasure...？ A mystery.)
I'm sorry. Recently, it seems my battery is running low too fast.
Before I met you, I didn't use my phone that much...
(My fault, huh... I kind of like that！)
By the way, how's your battery been doing now？
Well... I was told I should replace the battery, so I asked Papa, you know？
He frowned and went completely silent.
I didn't say anything about texting you, you know？ But he seemed to figure it out.
Mama was amazed too, since he's not usually that perceptive.
So it's on hold for now.
But I'll be careful not to let it run out, so don't worry, okay？
About your phone battery. Did your dad give in？
Rather than Papa, I gave in.
I thought if I used it more cleverly, the battery might last longer.
I see... Then we'd better look up how to make the battery last longer？
I got a new battery for my phone.
He looked up a service that replaces it for free. Papa did.
Yes, secretly. Mama laughed and said he's never honest.
...Your father is actually a kind guy.
Papa is always kind, you know？ Kind, and scary.
Thank you. I have to take good care of it.
Huh？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you wearing something today？
Like perfume... you smell different than usual.
...Ah. Maybe because I changed fabric softener？
Ah, I see. Yeah, it's pretty nice.
I realized it makes me happy when someone notices little changes.
Especially when it's you. ...What do I do？ I can't stop smiling.
!? Y-Yes. I just started using a new one today.
Sure！ I don't miss even the smallest change！
Ah... you remembered what I said makes me happy...
It's always like this with you. Is it okay for so many good things to happen to me？
？ What's wrong？ Staring at me like that...
Umm, you know？ How should I say it...
It makes me happiest when you notice naturally.
When you do it like this, it feels like you're playing spot-the-difference...
No, I'm glad you care. Thank you.
Yes. I switched back to my old fabric softener.
Dealing with girls is hard, isn't it？
Hey, if you notice anything you don't like or that's not good, tell me, okay？
I'm sure there'll be lots of things. So we'll solve them one at a time, and――
Hey, why do we have to study, I wonder？
Eh!? What's this, all of a sudden？
Yes... a kid in my neighborhood asked me.
I answered that it's for when you grow up, and they asked, "Will it really be useful later？"...
When I thought about it, I study just because I like it... so I couldn't say anything.
What do I say if they ask again？ Hmm...
That talk we had about why we study... I asked Mama too.
"To broaden your connections with people by broadening your knowledge," she said.
"But that's just my reason. Find your own reason to study, Manaka," she said.
Yes. It's an adult's opinion, right？ It feels a little different from the studying we mean.
I've been thinking about this so much lately that I can't focus in class.
I want to find the answer quickly...
(If her grades drop over this, that'd defeat the whole point.)
I asked Papa too, why we study. He said it's so you won't regret it later.
If you try to do what you did in middle and high school as an adult, you can't without courage and drive.
So while you're somewhere you have to study, do it even if you hate it, and if it wasn't enough, make it up as an adult. That's the smart way, he said.
He insisted he couldn't be wrong, since he's the one with regrets.
It seems it wasn't nearly enough. He says if he had time, he'd like to study even now.
Even though he stays up late after clinic hours studying outside his specialty, you know？
(So ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s love of studying comes from her dad... I see.)
About why we study. Have you seen the kid who asked since then？
No. But next time they ask, I'll answer properly, okay？
"I don't know if all of it will be useful when you grow up," I'll say.
Well, I can't lie, can I？
But since you don't know when you'll need it, you prepare for it.
Phew. Finally, it's all cleared up.
Now you can take a breather？
Yes, now I can enjoy studying purely.
A friend in class was playing a game and I had a look.
And there was one thing that bugged me...
The boy hero called himself "Ore-sama"... What do you think a girl would say？
Is that weird？ If you don't know that, girls can't relate to him, right？
So I thought about it... "Watashi-sama" sounds weird... Would "Manaka-sama" work？
About the girl version of "Ore-sama" we talked about？
My aunt and grandmother use it normally...
Mama says it in public places too.
(Depends on where and who's using it, I guess.)
Last time we talked about "Ore-sama" being "Watakushi," right？
"Atakushi" might be even closer, she said.
I got curious and looked it up. There are so many ways to say "I."
Atai's Manaka Takane, Manaka Takane of the tennis club, see！
Um... forget that？ No way？ I'm not doing it again, okay？
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. About trying out different ways to say "I" that you mentioned.
Not quite. The sentence ending, for one.
Hey, that's enough, right？ That's it.
...They said it must be hard having a popular boyfriend.
But everyone says so, you know？
And you're this wonderful, so there's no way you're not popular, right？
(Should I be happy about this, or... hmm...)
Hey. About that thing you said, me being popular.
That's definitely a lie. They were pulling your leg, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
How can you be so sure？
I wish I could hide you somewhere.
(Being this jealous over me... not bad, actually？)
You're so wonderful... Everyone has no taste, huh.
...Ah, is this the me-being- popular thing？ So it was wrong after all？
Yes. Apparently you're crazy popular... with me.
I see, so that's what it was. Yeah, they got it right！
Huh？ The misunderstanding's cleared up, so why the face？
(Do you want me to be popular or not？ Which is it？)
That me-being-popular thing you mentioned... Anything since？
Sorry about that time. I took everyone's joke seriously and acted strange...
Haha, it's fine. Anyway, I'm glad the misunderstanding's cleared up.
Yes. Stay just as you are from now on, okay？
Please stay popular only with me▼
Of course！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, please stay popular only with me, too▼
Have you been making any sweets lately？
Why？ Is there something you want to eat？
Geez, saying that. Is anything really okay？
(Being teased by ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is kind of new...)
Well, I tried to make something a little unusual, and it's not going well...
If you're struggling, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, it must be tough, huh？
I have the base taste, but I still feel like I'm missing something...
By the way, what are you making？
Don't worry？ I'll make it taste good.
You said anything was fine, so I took the plunge.
It seems they were just Papa's taste.
"These are Papa's！" he said, keeping them all to himself. Mama and I only got a taste.
Hm？ Weren't you against natto biscotti？
Hehe！ Sorry, I was being mean.
▲高嶺＊＊▲... aren't you starting to enjoy teasing me？
...Because you look so cute when you're flustered.
It makes me want to hug you. Is that bad？
If I drink coffee at night, will I not be able to sleep？
A friend of Papa's sent us some coffee beans that are supposed to be really good.
It has a very good scent and looks delicious...
Wouldn't you be fine？ You're used to caffeine from tea, probably.
You think so？ Yes... maybe I'll give it a try？
(Seems like she could just drink it during the day... oh well.)
Oh right, how was that coffee you mentioned？
Because you won't be able to sleep？
Yes. He said I really shouldn't even drink black tea...
Huh... But you're fine with it, right？
Yes... Maybe he's keeping it to himself because it's good？
No way, that can't be it.
We spoke about coffee before... Do you remember it？
Ah, the one your dad won't let you drink？
Yes. I asked him. "Is it no because it's delicious？"
"If you insist, try it the night before a day off," he said.
Yes. But when he puts it that way, now I'm a little scared...
Why is that？ When I'm told to do something, I don't want to, and when I'm told no, I want to. Am I being a child？
Ah. By the way... how was the coffee？
I tried it a while ago. Espresso, cafe au lait... and also black. It was delicious▼
Yes. Thanks to that, I was wide awake, and even when it got light outside, I wasn't sleepy...
Yes. So I think I'll pass on coffee for a while？
But next time I want to drink it with you. Night would be trouble, so in the morning, okay？
Um... Did I say something strange？
(She doesn't get how that sounds... probably...)
Yes. There's a big boy in my class...
He's been slimming down little by little. It's become the talk among the girls.
Because of him, it's a bit of a diet boom right now.
Maybe I'll jump on the bandwagon too？ ...Just kidding.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ paying attention to another guy... hmm.)
Remember the boy on a diet I told you about？
...He's in your class？ What about him？
He has a girl he likes in our class, and he's working hard so he can confess to her.
Yes. When I heard it, I really wanted to support him.
I hope both his diet and his love go well.
(The girl he likes being ▲高嶺＊＊▲... No way！)
That guy on the diet you mentioned...
Yes, it's going well. His goal is to lose 15 kilos, and he's already lost 8.
The power of love really is amazing, isn't it？
What, all of a sudden？ I think you're fine just as you are？
Seven kilos to go... If he succeeds, maybe I'll ask him his secret？
Hey, listen？ About the boy on a diet. An amazing fact came to light.
There's another girl in our class who's been dieting？ It seems she was the one.
I-I see... So that's all... I see...
Two one-sided loves that were mutual. Kind of ticklish, isn't it？
Lately, it's been hard to be at home on my days off...
...You know？ Papa and Mama are very close.
No, not like that. They're lovey-dovey.
Hmm, how do I put it？ I'm happy for them, but it's embarrassing...
Ah, that's it！ I can't tell them not to get along... What do you think I should do？
Are your father and mother lovey-dovey as usual？
I feel like I'm in the way.
Yeah, every day might be rough.
It's much better than them not getting along, but I wish they'd think about their daughter a little.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, they're still showing off in front of you？
Even though they have a teenage daughter？
Well, that daughter's also lovey-dovey outside the house.
...Yes. So maybe I'm not in a position to say anything？
Then their daughter will put up with it. Just kidding.
You know, just when I'd resigned myself, Papa and Mama went back to normal.
Whoa. Maybe they noticed you watching, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Geez, don't make me sound like a peeping tom.
Haha, sorry. But why did they go back to normal？
I don't know. They were lovey-dovey until a little while ago, but suddenly they both got shy.
Something must have happened that only they know about.
Yes... But being able to fall in love even as you get older is wonderful, isn't it？
Aiming to be like the Takane couple？
Aiming to beat the Takane couple！ Hehe！
Did you sleep on it wrong？
Maybe you slept in a weird position, or it's your pillow.
Maybe the pillow. It's my favorite and I've used it a long time, so maybe it doesn't fit anymore.
Grandmother bought it for me, so that's why.
But maybe I should replace it soon.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ seems like she takes good care of her things.)
By the way, how about your pillow？ Get a new one？
Not yet. I went to a department store, but couldn't find one that felt right.
But you know？ When I asked a clerk, they suggested a custom-made one.
They explained a lot and it sounded interesting, so I think I'll try it.
Want to make a matching one too？
How do you make one of those custom pillows you mentioned？
You choose the height, the shape... and the material too. There's so much freedom, I can't decide.
I have to decide soon, but...
I see... And you're thinking, "Maybe the one I have now is fine？" Something like that？
You were torn about it, but did you order the pillow？
I see. Are you looking forward to it？
Yes▼ If it's comfortable, I'll recommend it to you too, okay？
Please！ Until it arrives, shall I lend you my lap？
A guy's lap pillow would be gross, right！ Haha！
No, nothing！ I wonder if my pillow will come soon.
Hey, have you ever had a dream come true？
A dream coming true, huh... Have you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
The Takane family has always seasoned it with soy sauce, right？ But in my dream, Mama suddenly said, "This year we're using white miso！"
A first dream of the year come true？ Oh, the first dream is on New Year's night, so not quite.
Hehe, right. And then, I went to the kitchen thinking, "No way..."
And it was white miso ozoni.
Yes. I was so surprised. But it's kind of a waste, right？ If one of my dreams was going to come true, I wish it was a different one.
By the way. About that dream-coming-true thing you told me.
Is there some trick to it？ A way to have dreams that come true？
Who knows？ But that dream was what I got after doing all sorts of things to have a good dream.
I put a picture of a treasure ship under my pillow, wrote a charm on it, read a book on controlling dreams.
You really go all out, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Did I do something wrong？ Instead of a lucky dream, I had one that came true.
But the ozoni had eggplant in it！ That's lucky, right？
Ah, sorry. That was the ozoni in my dream...
Speaking of which. Did something happen in the year you had the dream of miso and eggplant？
...I want to have a good dream again.
Ah, you dodged it. Not fair！
About the dreams-coming-true thing we talked about...
I might have had one. A dream that comes true.
Yes. I was with you, and...
...If you tell people, it won't come true, so that's all.
I wonder if you'll have the same dream？
Hey. Can you do any impressions？
Impressions？ Hmm... What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I can do a pro wrestler impression, you know？
Pro wrestling!? Who taught you that!?
Huh？ Um, a girl in my class... my rival.
Ah, her... Yeah, I see. Yeah.
...Did you think a boy taught me？
You're jealous. That makes me kind of happy... Just kidding▼
I forgot！ Your pro wrestler impression！
Too bad. I'll show you my imitation next time, okay？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. About that impressions thing the other day...
！ That's only if you do yours first――
Antony Enoki impression！ Okay, your turn, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...Um？ I would be happy if you could wait for a while...
(No way... did we pick the same act!?)
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, have you picked up any new impressions？
Um... it's that guy from a famous quiz show, right？ Everyone says it's a good likeness...
Hey. How can someone get better at putting in eye drops？
Every time, Papa or I put them in for her.
Wouldn't your dad know more about it？
I think so too, but for some reason he doesn't want to teach Mama.
Hmm... why, I wonder？ It's strange.
Your mom didn't get better, huh.
Yes. I heard it helps to rest your fist on your cheekbone for support, so I taught her right away.
But when Mama does it, they go toward her nose...
Yes, that seems to be part of it. She closes her eyes, too. She says she'll keep trying, but the eye drops will probably run out first.
(Your mom must really be bad at it...)
